parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols bfd interface ge-1/0/0 loc.command: set protocols bfd interface ge-1/0/0 local-discriminator 2
set protocols bfd interface ge-1/0/0 loc.explanation: 配置BFD接口的本地标识符。

set protocols bfd interface ge-1/0/0 rem.command: set protocols bfd interface ge-1/0/0 remote-discriminator 1
set protocols bfd interface ge-1/0/0 rem.explanation: 配置BFD接口的远端标识符。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet6 address 2001:db8::2/32
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址及前缀长度。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 enable
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet6 enable
